olivia_csm: Ravenbrook renewal flagged for Q2. They're seeing p95 spikes during peak and asked about lowering unit costs. Proposing a 10% canary using an int8 quant of m-raven-v2 + route non-critical flows to m-small-v1. Need ops/SRE signoff and customer approval.

maria_cs: They'll ask for savings numbers and rollback timing. Can we give a % estimate and SLA?

olivia_csm: From last 48h: p50 160ms, p95 420ms, occasional tails to 1.2s at concurrency >80. Current cost ~ $420 / 1M tokens. Int8 estimate: ~30-40% compute savings; median latency +10-30ms but higher throughput reduces queueing and may reduce tail.

ash_engineer: I can build an int8 artifact and run eval on a 200-sample set. Suggest 48h canary at 5-10% traffic with automated metrics + manual review. Need customer's eval set and regression thresholds.

leo_sre: Infra asks to bump min replicas for canary pool and enable prefix caching for repeated assistant prompts. I'll add an alert: p95 > 700ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> rollback. Also route embeddings and batch jobs to m-small-v1 during canary.

olivia_csm: Draft message to Ravenbrook: "We propose a brief 48h canary using a quantized variant to reduce unit costs while monitoring quality closely. We'll roll back within 30 minutes if metrics exceed thresholds." Thoughts?

maria_cs: Add the explicit rollback SLA and include estimated savings percent in the note. I'll add the plan to Gainsight for renewal talking points.

nash_engineer: Canary deploy command I'll run:```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer ravenbrook --model m-raven-v2:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag canary-raven-2026-03
```

deploy-bot: Canary started (id: rb-canary-9b2). Weight 10% -> us-west-2.

olivia_csm: Action items: ash -> eval & manual sample (ETA 12h). leo -> confirm autoscale & alerts (ETA 2h). olivia -> customer outreach & SLA wording (ETA 4h). Reconvene 24h after start. :+1:
